no-restricted-syntax.message: Use userEvent (from @testing-library/user-event) instead of fireEvent for React 19 + Concurrent rendering compatibility. 例外は keyboard event 等の限定ケースのみ: 直前行に `// eslint-disable-next-line no-restricted-syntax -- @allow-fireEvent: <理由>` を付与してください。詳細: docs/04-development/TESTING_GUIDE.md
